newsitem.title: USA: Sodak Gaming sees Q4 EPS of $0.04-$0.07.
newsitem.headline: Sodak Gaming sees Q4 EPS of $0.04-$0.07.

text.p: Sodak Gaming Inc said Thursday it expects to report earnings for its fourth quarter 1996 in the $0.04 to $0.07 a share range, lower than the company had expected.
Sodak said in a news release that its fourth quarter earnings and revenues were hurt by delays in some product orders and severe weather conditions hindering travel and commerce.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates for fourth quarter earnings was $0.13 a share versus $0.21 a share the previous year.
"The fourth quarter will be profitable but less than we had planned," Michael Wordeman, chairman and chief executive of Sodak, said in a statement.
